profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Grainger
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineering leader with 14+ years of experience designing and delivering cloud-native, distributed systems across financial services and healthcare. My background spans hands-on engineering, architecture, engineering management, and applied AI, enabling me to connect technical execution with business strategy while building scalable platforms and high-performing teams.
Currently, I lead the development of event-driven microservices at JPMorgan Chase using Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Redis, and AWS, with a focus on resilient, high-throughput, mission-critical platforms. I also actively apply Generative AI and agentic AI to improve engineering productivity, operational efficiency, and developer workflows.
My AI experience includes building production alert-triage agents, onboarding assistants, custom RAG solutions, and AI-powered workflows for vulnerability remediation, API/Postman automation, documentation, and unit, E2E, and acceptance-test generation. I work with LLMs, prompt and context engineering, RAG, AI agents, LangChain, GitHub Copilot, Claude, and OpenAI APIs, with a focus on practical enterprise adoption, evaluation, guardrails, and reliability.
Previously, I spent 5+ years as an Engineering Manager at Oracle, leading engineering teams, driving cloud modernization, establishing engineering best practices, and delivering enterprise solutions across AWS, Salesforce, and microservices architectures. I enjoy staying hands-on with architecture, system design, and development while mentoring engineers and driving technical strategy.
Core Expertise:
• Distributed Systems & Microservices
• Java • Spring Boot • Kafka • REST APIs
• AWS • Kubernetes • Docker • Cloud Architecture
• PostgreSQL • Cassandra • Redis • Oracle
• Generative AI • Agentic AI • RAG • LLM Integration
• CI/CD • DevOps • Observability
• Software Architecture & System Design
• Technical Leadership • Engineering Management
I'm interested in connecting with teams building scalable platforms, cloud-native systems, AI-enabled products and developer experiences, and high-performance distributed systems.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Leading the modernization of enterprise contact center platforms by designing and delivering cloud-native, event-driven solutions that improve scalability, resilience, and operational efficiency. Driving technical strategy, mentoring engineers, and collaborating across engineering and product organizations to deliver business-critical capabilities. Spearheading the adoption of Generative AI by developing AI-powered engineering solutions using LLMs, AI agents, and developer copilots to automate development workflows, production troubleshooting, code generation, testing, and technical documentation.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Framework · Apache Kafka · REST APIs · Cassandra · DB2

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: Managed a team of software engineers delivering mission-critical enterprise applications, providing technical leadership, architectural guidance, and career mentorship. Partnered with product, architecture, and business stakeholders to modernize enterprise platforms, streamline development processes, improve release quality, and successfully deliver multiple strategic initiatives on schedule.
positions.insights: Skills: Salesforce.com Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · People Management · Spring Boot · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Recently, Cerner has collaborated with Salesforce, the global leader in customer relationship management (CRM). Cerner is extending its population health, clinical and administration portfolio with an integrated solution that combines Salesforce Health Cloud and Marketing Cloud with Cerner’s HealtheIntentSM, its big data platform.

Developing Cloud-based software applications using Microservices architecture, Ruby on Rails, RESTful APIs, MySql DB. Also, leading the development of Salesforce-Cerner connection to send required data to Salesforce Health cloud using Salesforce Bulk API 2.0

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Developed a financial application enabling administrators and users to establish, maintain, submit payment for, and close loans.
